labels.F1p: F1' = F0 + register-1.1.0 QUALIFIED chains, registered V13 frame rule (primary of this study)
labels.F1dp: F1d' = same chains, registration-2.0.0 drop rule (sensitivity)
labels.cited: F0/F1/F1w from V13 s1-signal-1.0.0.json, F1d from V13b results-2.0.0.json (unchanged)

returnBasis.events: PRICE_RETURN (split-adjusted weekly closes; delisted: provider close / later split factors)
returnBasis.benchmark: SPY PRICE_RETURN same entry/exit dates (terminal outcomes: entry date to expected exit calendar date)

benchmark.rule: SPY price return between the same entry and exit dates; events without both SPY dates are excluded from the SPY endpoint and counted.

inference.primary: research-validation.inferTemporalBlockMean: circular calendar-block bootstrap over the study calendar (all weeks 2000-2025 incl. zero-event weeks; all listings of a week move together = clustering by date), basic centered interval, two-sided p.
inference.blockLength: b = 52 weeks for h <= 26, b = 104 for h = 52 (>= 2h for the 52-week overlap)
inference.secondary: research-studies.inference two-way cluster (signal date x issuer), asymptotic; used for regime, subperiod and descriptive tables.
inference.engineBudget: If a cell has more than 100,000 events (engine observation budget), the block inference uses the 100,000 events with the smallest sha256("V10-STUDIES-SUBSAMPLE-1.0.0|" + securityId + "|" + signalDate); the point estimate is reported on all events. Pre-registered, outcome-free.
inference.assumption: CONDITIONAL_WEAK_STATIONARITY_AND_MIXING (V9 found the SPY-excess series instationary; SPY-excess inference is reported but its p-values are interpreted with that limitation).

variants.v10: V10 semantics: engine outcomes, CENSORED excluded (registered S1 result)
variants.terminalS0: terminal-resolved, scenario 0 = last traded close (registered point estimate of the survivorship decomposition; amendment O1-O4)
variants.terminalBand: scenarios S1 (MERGER -10 %, DISTRESS/UNKNOWN -30 %) and S2 (MERGER +10 %, DISTRESS/UNKNOWN -100 %)

multipleTesting.note: Six Holm families of 60 (frame x variant). No test on deltas.

fundedStrategy.note: Part of signal-study.cjs output, unchanged. The V10 funded universe admits only listings whose series reach the last strategy session (2026); delisted chains enter only if they traded until then (delisted in 2026, after the signal window). Differences between frames therefore come from a few late-ended chains and the changed hash tie-break candidate set, not from the population of 2000-2025 delistings. Descriptive only.

scope: Retrospective development study on explored 2000-2025 history; adds 13 source-backed delisted chains (register 1.1.0) to the V13 frames. Long event outcomes only; weekly price return; terminal values are scenarios. Not a certification, no alpha claim.
